title: Quenched Citrusy Norwegian Salmon Bowl
description: A citrusy and springy Norwegian dish featuring salmon, celery salt, and a mediterranean twist, served in a beautiful lacquerware bowl. This recipe combines the freshness of citrus with the indulgence of salmon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the salmon fillets on it.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salmon and sprinkle with garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Bake the salmon in the oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, mix the lemon juice and water in a bowl.
Add the sodium alginate to the lemon juice mixture and stir well.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the lemon juice mixture into a bath of cold water to create citrus spheres.
Once the salmon is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
To serve, place a salmon fillet in each lacquerware bowl, sprinkle with celery salt, parsley, and dill, and top with citrus spheres.
Drizzle any remaining lemon juice over the top and serve immediately.
